items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Well that’s when Elvis Presley came out, around that time. And he kind of changed everything for musicians and jazz musicians especially.

ctx.x: So the popular music of that time, they were leaning towards rock & roll.

Well that’s when Elvis Presley came out, around that time. And he kind of changed everything for musicians and jazz musicians especially. Because everybody started to like rock & roll then, and that type of music. Our type of music went in the background, and it still hasn’t come back yet, but it’s starting to come through a little bit now I think.
So what kind of music would you play for school dances?
